Cases by appliance

Work we can show,
appliance by appliance.

Each tile is a finished visit: the fault, the part and the invoice price. Hover to read it, click to open the photo in a new tab.

  • Refrigerator not cooling · $310 Sub-Zero, North Park. Defrost heater and thermistor replaced in one visit, same day. Open photo
  • Freezer not freezing · $295 Whirlpool, Mira Mesa. Start relay and evaporator fan motor replaced; tested at temperature. Open photo
  • Ice maker stopped · $260 KitchenAid, La Jolla. Water inlet valve and filter changed, line flushed and tested. Open photo
  • Washer leaking at the door · $245 LG, Chula Vista. Door boot and drain pump replaced. The customer approved the price before we started. Open photo
  • Dryer not heating · $210 Maytag, La Mesa. Thermal fuse and blocked vent cleared; the flat rate held. Open photo
  • Washer not spinning · $265 Samsung, City Heights. Drive belt and door lock assembly replaced, spin cycle tested. Open photo
  • Oven won't heat · $268 Whirlpool, La Mesa. Bake element and thermostat replaced; tested at temperature before we left. Open photo
  • Stove igniter not sparking · $185 GE, Encinitas. Spark module and one igniter replaced; all four burners lighting again. Open photo
  • Microwave not heating · $165 Sharp, Hillcrest. Magnetron and diode replaced, leakage checked and signed off on the invoice. Open photo
  • Dishwasher not draining · $230 Bosch, Normal Heights. Drain pump replaced and the filter housing cleaned; cycle finished dry. Open photo
  • Dishwasher leaking underneath · $195 KitchenAid, Carlsbad. Door gasket and water inlet valve replaced, floor under the unit dried and checked. Open photo
  • Prep fridge down before service · $420 True, East Village. Compressor start components and condenser cleaned; back to temperature by 4 PM. Open photo
  • Commercial dishwasher not filling · $390 Hobart, Mission Valley. Water inlet valve and float switch replaced; one invoice for the property. Open photo
